title: Figure 12: Typical atmospheric absorption and scattering in the infrared
description: Log-scale plot of Extinction (1/km) from 0.0001 to 10 versus Wavelength (µ) from about 1 to 4.5, with curves for Total Extinction, Total Scattering and Total Absorption. Labeled laser lines include YAG 1.06µ, COIL 1.315µ, HF overtone 1.4µ, HF 2.8µ and MIRACL 3.5-4.0µ. Caption reads "Figure 12. Typical Atmospheric Absorption and Scattering in the Infrared."
